title: Two clocks may disagree forever
hook: Two clocks may disagree forever. Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Integer remainders, gcd, primes, modular exponentiation.
doesNotKnow: Merge congruences with noncoprime moduli only when residues agree modulo their gcd.

misconception: The Chinese remainder theorem always gives a solution for any pair of clocks.
objective: Merge congruences with noncoprime moduli only when residues agree modulo their gcd.

claims.text: Noncoprime congruences agree only when their residue difference is divisible by the common gcd. The merged modulus is the least common multiple, and the witness checks both original residues.
